links.outcome: AI oral condition detection versus dentist reference on local participant photographs; agreement and accuracy
links.effect: Overall sensitivity 73.6%, precision 46.0%, accuracy 47.3%, macro Cohen's kappa 0.010; near-zero specificity for decay, tooth wear, discoloration; optimization needed before screening workflow integration.
links.quote: Smilo.ai demonstrated an overall sensitivity of 73.6%, precision of 46.0%, accuracy of 47.3%, and a macro-level Cohen's κ of 0.010 relative to dentist assessments.

screen.reason: Analytical validation study comparing diagnostic performance of an AI tool (Smilo.ai) against dentists on oral photographs. It does not evaluate a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
